loginText: Sign in to your UniHub account.
welcomeTitle: Make room for your next move.
welcomeText: A new skill. A fresh perspective. Your next workshop is waiting.
homeText: Explore university workshops and make time for something new.
temporaryText: Set a new password before you continue. You’ll be signed in as soon as it’s updated.
missingCredentials: Enter your email and temporary password to continue.
passwordHelp: Use 8–255 characters with uppercase and lowercase letters, a number, and a special character (! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) , . ? : { } | < > or a quotation mark). Choose a password different from your temporary password.
passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. You’re signed in.
required: Enter a value for this field.
emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, up to 254 characters.
passwordInvalid: Enter your password, up to 255 characters.
newInvalid: Your new password must meet the requirements below.
samePassword: Choose a password different from your temporary password.
invalid: The email or password is incorrect. Try again.
disabled: This account is not active. Contact your organization for help.
unavailable: We can’t connect right now. Check your connection and try again.
rate: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
storage: This tab can’t save your session. Reloading will require you to sign in again.
expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
unknownPassword: Your password may already have changed
unknownPasswordText: We couldn’t confirm the result. Try signing in with your new password. If it wasn’t changed, you can try this step again.
notTemporary: This account no longer uses a temporary password. Sign in with your current password.
restoringText: One moment while we get you back to where you left off.
restoreErrorText: Your account content is locked until we can reconnect. Check your connection, then try again.
signingOutText: Your account content is locked while we finish signing out.
logoutErrorText: Your account content is locked. Try again to confirm sign out, or remove this session from this browser.
removeText: This removes access from this browser tab. It doesn’t confirm that the session has been revoked by the service, and won’t sign out your other tabs or devices.
localRemoved: Local session removed. Service sign out was not confirmed.
denied: You don’t have access to this page
deniedText: Choose a page available to your account.
missingOrg: We couldn’t verify your organization. Contact your organization for help.
notFoundText: Check the address or return to the home page.
aboutText: UniHub brings university workshops together in one place.
gettingStartedText: Browse workshops as a visitor. Sign in to continue with your account.
accessibilityText: Use your keyboard to move between controls. Language and appearance controls are available in the header.
footer: Learn something new. Meet your kind of people.
